<thought>After several attempts, the template search with functional‑group filters did not return a relevant Michael‑addition/cyclization template. The most direct way to obtain the required information is to retrieve the template that matches the target flavanone product directly, without additional filters. I will search the catalog using only the target SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
